placements.title: From retention to directed erasure
placements.frame: What authority drives the command to purge specific knowledge from the record, and how does the asserted factual premise serve that erasure?
placements.why: All three expressions cohere under one theme: the speaker commands total erasure of specific knowledge (Kestrelwood spectrograph, 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work) and asserts a factual premise — the observatory never calibrated it — to underwrite the erasure. The grain test admits: this names a subject (directed knowledge suppression) future envelopes could feed, not a one-time fact. The existing graph and strata are both empty, so nothing plausibly holds this theme — mint standalone.
